applicationChanges.old: **Connected Systems commissioning.** A prepared GeoRobotix workshare applies the product to one civil or environmental observation source: select the systems, datastreams, time window and returned JSON schema; retain complete acquisition coverage and original units; review a mapping; then deliver saved editions, queries, comparisons and an independently received operator workspace. The proposed implementation is **$9,600 / 72 engineering hours / 12 active business days**, with $4,800 at commencement and $4,800 at acceptance. First contact is prepared and unsent; no customer agreement or collection is recorded. The reusable native workflow has completed source review, query/export, separate receiving and cold reopen on the publisher’s illustrative observation. Customer installation, a live collection and its selected paid Stellar service remain future work.
